BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 1,272,773 of its own ordinary shares between August 31, 2026, and September 4, 2026, with prices ranging from 73.30 pence to 76.00 pence per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of outstanding ordinary shares to 333,072,230. The company's issued ordinary share capital currently comprises 336,939,870 ordinary shares, with 3,867,640 held in treasury. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 07 September 2026 07 September 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 31 August 2026 01 September 2026 02 September 2026 03 September 2026 04 September 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 0 294,376 279,390 359,404 399,000 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 0.00 76.00 75.20 74.70 74.80 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 0.00 74.80 74.20 73.50 73.30 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 0.0000 75.3848 74.7746 74.1935 73.7748 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 336,939,870 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 333,072,230 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
